meta.title: Recurring Events: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Buyer on the specified Enterprise tenant and verify that recurring-event scheduling is refused or absent.
Sign in as a Buyer on the same tenant and verify that recurring-event scheduling is available, then compare the two role outcomes.
Verify that the tenant is Enterprise because no tenant identifier or plan-inspection step is provided.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a non-Buyer on the specified Enterprise tenant and verify that recurring-event scheduling is refused or absent.; Sign in as a Buyer on the same tenant and verify that recurring-event scheduling is available, then compare the two role outcomes.; Verify that the tenant is Enterprise because no tenant identifier or plan-inspection step is provided.

steps.note: Open the events list where the Recurring Events area is available.
Confirm the events list rendered before inspecting recurring events.
Navigate to the Recurring Events area that is the subject of the access check.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer and then the Buyer on the same Enterprise tenant, attempt to schedule a recurring event in each session, and record whether the action is refused or unavailable for the non-Buyer and available for the Buyer

steps.note: Alternate role credentials and the tenant context are required to test the RBAC comparison.
Leave a known Recurring Events control as the final screen assertion.
